stem.en: A wave's amplitude is tripled while its frequency stays fixed. What happens to the energy it carries?
stem.et: Laine amplituud kolmekordistatakse, sagedust muutmata. Mis juhtub selle kantava energiaga?

label.en: It increases ninefold, since energy is proportional to the square of amplitude
label.et: See kasvab üheksa korda, sest energia on võrdeline amplituudi ruuduga

label.en: It is unchanged, since energy depends only on frequency
label.et: See ei muutu, sest energia sõltub ainult sagedusest

label.en: It cannot be determined without knowing the wave's frequency as well
label.et: Seda ei saa kindlaks teha, teadmata ka laine sagedust
